title: **Armed terrorist hanged in Kerman**
text:
**Armed terrorist hanged in Kerman**"

"KERMAN - October 14, 2026 -- Ali Sina Mostafavi, an armed terrorist and an agent of the US-Zionist enemy during the Ramadan War, was executed by hanging. He was accused of carrying out armed attacks in Kerman against Iranian citizens in support of Reza Pahlavi and the Zionist regime."

"The case file says he carried out multiple shootings in Kerman, wounding several citizens and a young girl. He was also accused of filming enemy projectile impact sites during the Ramadan War and sending the footage to anti-Iranian networks, and of expressing readiness to carry out a terrorist operation at Kerman airport."
